default_ui_policy: 只显示 user_presentation 和 target_display；内部传输字段只进入高级诊断

next_action_policy.object_level_rule: 顶层 response.next_action 是唯一可执行的对象级主动作；UI、重放和状态投影不得从 payload 内字段重新推断对象级动作
next_action_policy.payload_level_rule: 现有 result.payload.data.next_action 仅作为兼容性镜像或局部结果提示；若它表示同一对象，服务端必须与顶层 response.next_action 完全一致，UI 不得以它覆盖顶层值
next_action_policy.item_level_rule: 批量逐项结果或列表项中的 items[].next_action 可以指向该项自己的动作，但必须标明为项级上下文，不能提升为响应级主动作
next_action_policy.new_schema_rule: 新增响应不得增加根 data.next_action；需要项级动作时只能放在明确的 item/result context 内

canonical_mutation_envelope.target_refs: existing resources only; created result is never supplied as a target
canonical_mutation_envelope.expected_revisions: same exact set as target_refs; new-resource actions use []
canonical_mutation_envelope.input_snapshot_refs: optional system-level input references; create_job and analyze_coverage use payload.source_refs[] instead
canonical_mutation_envelope.selection_ref: top-level immutable selection snapshot with selection_id, revision and items[].revision
canonical_mutation_envelope.attempt_ref: top-level external attempt marker required only by the action catalog
canonical_mutation_envelope.workspace_binding: authenticated current workspace is included in the operation reservation key and digest; it is not user-editable payload
canonical_mutation_envelope.idempotency_digest: workspace_id + action + route + canonical target_refs + canonical expected_revisions + selection_ref identity/revisions + attempt_ref identity/fence + operation_id + retry_of_operation_id when present + canonical payload
canonical_mutation_envelope.target_order: sort and deduplicate target_refs and expected_revisions by object_type then id
canonical_mutation_envelope.secret_boundary: only provider-configuration.v1 payload.api_key is write-only and local-loopback scoped

durable_operation_policy.atomic_reserve: reserve_or_replay executes under the workspace writer lock before any target mutation, outbox enqueue or external dispatch
durable_operation_policy.same_digest: return the persisted first response or an in-progress operation; never execute the action again
durable_operation_policy.different_digest: return 409 with the existing operation target and a refresh action
durable_operation_policy.recovery: reserved/prepared without a committed workspace head is either completed from its marker or rejected as uncommitted; an external dispatch marker remains unknown until probed
durable_operation_policy.no_duplicate_store: job-local operation files are projections only and cannot be queried or written as an operation authority
durable_operation_policy.retry_identity: one operation_id has one business execution and one commit marker; every retry action must allocate a new operation_id and persist retry_of_operation_id; the original operation is replay-only

workspace_transaction_policy.writer_lock: one exclusive workspace writer lock serializes reservation, target CAS and head commit; external network calls never hold the lock
workspace_transaction_policy.crash_recovery: head replacement without final journal is completed from a committed marker; prepared revisions without a visible head are ignored and their staging intent is marked discarded while the operation settles as terminal_rejected
workspace_transaction_policy.atomicity_invariant: a mutation exposes either all target revisions from the new head or none of them

packet_attempt_policy.single_writer_gate: only the active attempt whose generation equals Packet.retry_generation may write candidates, Packet state or Job aggregates
packet_attempt_policy.retry_commit: consume retry authorization, increment retry_generation, create one not_started attempt and replace active_attempt_id in one Packet CAS
packet_attempt_policy.late_attempt: an old fence may append diagnostics only; it cannot change business projections
packet_attempt_policy.retry_operation_binding: retry authorization and retry_of_operation_id bind the new operation to the exact source target, source revision and source attempt

job_control_policy.marker_commit_rule: pause/cancel/resume writes a durable control marker under the workspace writer lock; the requested Job state is not projected as settled until the marker is committed
job_control_policy.recovery_rule: pending plus a valid owner lease remains requested; committed is atomically reduced to the target state; unknown becomes needs_reconcile and requires reconcile_recovery
job_control_policy.claim_binding: every Packet claim stores the Job control_intent_generation and is rechecked immediately before external dispatch
job_control_policy.race_rule: claim and control mutation share the workspace writer lock; a generation mismatch releases the claim without dispatch, while a durable submitted marker is never faked as cancelled

action_reference_materialization_policy.source: route registry + action catalog + request schema + response payload schema
checks: payload_binding fields exist in the request payload and fixed values satisfy the schema
selection_ref requiredness matches selection action mode
target object types and conditional branches equal target_binding
action_reference_materialization_policy.new_resource_rule: a create action must resolve target_binding.reference_target to a concrete workspace, parent or input target before the created resource ID exists; created_result is output-only
action_reference_materialization_policy.failure: materialization error; never emit a clickable action with guessed route, ID, revision or payload
action_reference_materialization_policy.server_recheck: the server re-resolves every action reference before executing it

selection_materialization_policy.input: typed filter plus optional checked item IDs
selection_materialization_policy.output: new immutable selection_ref with query_hash, object_type and item revisions
selection_materialization_policy.client_rule: list actions may return a preview plus materialize_selection; only the server-issued materialize_selection response may provide selection_id, revision or item revisions

retry-operation.v1.conditional_payload_rules: empty for ordinary retry; retry_confirmation=true for zero-output retry; retry_authorization is required for unknown-result retry

reconcile-operation.v1.conditional_payload_rules: probe forbids resolution; resolve requires resolution

packet-reconcile.v1.conditional_payload_rules: probe forbids resolution; resolve requires resolution

provider-configuration.v1.conditional_payload_rules: set requires api_key; keep and clear forbid api_key

response_payload_policy.unlisted_schema_rule: error; no implicit generic payload fallback

effects.retain_external_unknown: persist external_unknown_closed and disable automatic retry
effects.retry_with_duplicate_warning: record explicit confirmation and return retry_allowed=true; do not dispatch from reconcile

unknown_result.retry_gate: only a separate retry action with retry_allowed=true may dispatch

outcomes.adopt_verified_commit: 收纳已核验 marker 后重新运行父对象 reducer，最终状态必须来自 Job 有效状态集合

completed_packets.description: 已成功结算的工作包；包含有候选、零输出或进入隔离的成功尝试，不包含 failed、unknown、running、pending、blocked、cancelled。
